interface.longDescription: Market AutoPilot helps users explore descriptive Romanian new-car registration data. Compare brand and model performance, inspect market share and year-over-year change, review county distribution, and follow monthly market trends. Results describe published historical observations and do not predict sales or establish commercial causality.
